name: section-location
title: Location Section
description: Where to find a business: address, phone, email and opening hours beside or below a map that loads only behind your consent gate, and links out to the map without one; two layouts (split, stacked), colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Split
layouts.description: The details beside the map from md (the map the wider column), the map below them on a phone; without a map, the details in one column; the default.
layouts.usage: <LocationSection layout="split" Gate={ConsentGate} content={{ title, contact, hours, map }} />

layouts.title: Stacked
layouts.description: The map above the details in one column at every width.
layouts.usage: <LocationSection layout="stacked" content={{ title, contact, hours, map: { title, href } }} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (split, stacked); a gated map whose host is not asked before consent; links out without JS; 3 sample brands, light and dark, 390/768/1280 px, 2 hosts; axe clean
postMessage: See components/section-location/README.md for the layouts, how to put the map behind your consent gate (Gate={ConsentGate}), the labels (German included) and the design tokens it reads.
